text: dsh-agent-lines 是面向 DSH 的多 Agent 会话协作插件：它把普通 DSH Session 注册为可寻址的成员线，并用本地 SQLite 保存线状态与消息。管理线可以创建成员 Session，成员通过工具查看团队、发送消息、读取收件箱并确认处理；投递循环负责将排队消息交给对应 Session，并对失败投递重试。消息支持回复关系、幂等键、去重窗口、有效期和禁止回复标记。适合希望在 DSH 中组织长期分工团队、保留成员间任务往来的用户。需要兼容版本的 DSH 与 Node.js，并使用本机 SQLite 存储。

dsh-agent-lines adds persistent agent lines to DSH. Managers create member Sessions; agents send messages, read inboxes, and acknowledge work. Local SQLite stores lines and messages. A delivery loop forwards tasks and retries failures. For DSH team coordination; requires compatible DSH and Node.js.
想让 DSH 里的多个 Agent 按固定角色长期协作。
有没有办法让一个负责人会话创建并管理多个成员会话？
我希望不同的 DSH 会话之间能可靠地传递任务消息。
关掉或重启后，Agent 之间未处理的消息还要保留下来。
I want several DSH agents to coordinate through persistent, addressable team lines.
Can a manager session create worker sessions and send them tasks?
I need messages between agent sessions to remain queued until delivery.
How can agents acknowledge messages after handling them?
dsh-agent-lines 的功能「管理线创建成员线」：line_create 由配置的管理线调用，为成员分配角色与 Session，并注册为可寻址线；可选择工作区或工作目录。
dsh-agent-lines 的功能「线间持久消息」：line_send 将文本消息排入本地存储，可指定目标、回复关系、幂等键、有效期或禁止回复标记。
dsh-agent-lines 的功能「队列投递与重试」：后台投递循环领取目标线的待处理消息并交给对应 DSH Session；失败时按尝试次数安排重试或结束。
dsh-agent-lines 的功能「收件箱与确认」：成员可用 line_inbox 查看已投递消息，再用 line_ack 显式确认处理；确认不会删除消息。

GitHub: [Lencen/dsh-agent-lines](https://github.com/Lencen/dsh-agent-lines)

> DeepSeek Harness 社区插件，不是 DeepSeek 官方产品。

> **100% Vibe Coding。** 架构、代码、测试、文档都在 AI agent 会话中完成。它是实验性项目：生产使用前请审阅代码并跑一遍集成测试。

DSH 的 super agent 平替插件。

你不用每次新开会话、手动把背景复制给几个 agent。让一个负责人 agent 带一支长期协作的团队：每个成员有名字、各负责一块，任务和消息不会丢，结果由负责人汇总给你。

dsh-agent-lines README · 什么时候用：如果你遇到这些情况，再考虑安装：

- 你有一个长期项目，不想每次都从头解释背景；
- 你希望几个 agent 长期分工，比如调研、架构、开发、测试、发布、运维；
- 你需要给每个角色一个固定名字，能直接点名派任务；
- 任务做到一半关掉窗口、重启 DSH，消息和上下文还要在；
- 你希望一个负责人 agent 自己拆任务、建团队、追进度、收结果，最后向你汇报。

dsh-agent-lines README · 安装：一条命令安装（推荐，不需要自己找 profile）：

curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Lencen/dsh-agent-lines/main/install.sh -o install.sh
    bash install.sh

脚本会自动选择 DSH Web 使用的 profile，安装后检查 agent-lines 是否可用；如果判断不了，会列出已有配置并提示你怎么指定。

**安装或更新后必须重启 DSH Web。** 运行中的进程不会加载新插件代码。插件没有 config 时走零配置：启动一条未绑定 manager，根会话可以调用 line_claim_manager 自己绑定。显式“管理线配置”是可选的，用于固定 manager/worker。

离线或 npm 不可用时，用本地 tarball：

bash install.sh ./dsh-agent-lines-0.3.5.tgz

安装并重启后，不写配置也可以直接使用；需要固定管理线/worker 时，再把下面“管理线配置”粘贴到脚本打印的配置文件。

dsh-agent-lines README · 管理线配置（可选）：```yaml
- id: agent-lines
  name: dsh-agent-lines
  config:
    agentId: agent-demo

只有 `createFrom` 指定的线能调用 `line_create`。worker profile 不要开 `allowCreate`。

dsh-agent-lines README · 新线 bootstrap：管理线调用 line_create 创建新线时，插件默认排队一条不要求执行任务的 onboarding 消息，让空白 Session 产生第一条消息并出现在侧栏；传 bootstrap: false 可关闭。

line_status / line_list 会返回 materialized、visibleInSidebar、bootstrapQueued；新线在首条消息前可能仍是 blank。

dsh-agent-lines README · 快速开始：1. 运行上面的安装脚本。
2. **重启 DSH Web**，让插件加载。
3. 打开任意根会话。零配置路径不需要改 YAML。
4. 先调用 line_status；如果当前会话未绑定，调用 line_claim_manager({ confirm: "bind-manager" })。
5. 直接说“按首次使用创建团队”，然后等它建好成员线；第一个任务再单独发。

dsh-agent-lines README · 首次使用：组建开发团队：在新根会话里直接复制下面这段。它会先绑定管理线，再创建一支团队；后续任务再单独发，不要让它自己开工。

> 使用 dsh-agent-lines。先把这个会话设为开发团队的管理线；如果还没绑定，就先完成绑定。
>
> 你是开发团队负责人：负责任务拆解与分配、协调沟通、跟踪进度、汇总结果、总结汇报。你只做管理和协调，不执行具体开发任务。
>
> 请组建开发团队。成员名字用简短英文，岗位用中文：research（调研）、architecture（架构）、uiux（UIUX）、dev（开发）、test（测试）、acceptance（验收）、release（发布）、ops（运维）。
>
> 团队建好后先待命，不要自动开工，等我发第一个任务。

成员名字用英文短名，中文放在岗位上。这个提示词只创建一个团队；0.3 不支持同一插件实例同时多个团队。

text:
dsh-agent-lines README · 场景：一个管理线 + 多条执行线：负责人先建好团队，后面才是具体任务。

1. 负责人按角色建立成员：调研、架构、UIUX、开发、测试、验收、发布、运维。
2. 你给负责人一个具体任务，例如“给报表页加 CSV 导出，带测试和一页 runbook”。
3. 负责人把任务拆开，派给对应的成员；每条消息都会留在本地。
4. 成员收到任务、执行、确认收到，需要时回复负责人。
5. 负责人收集结果，处理成员之间的分歧，统一口径。
6. 你看到负责人的汇总；每个成员保留自己的上下文和消息记录。

这只是“用提示词组织团队”的方式，不是插件内置的组织架构；怎么拆任务由负责人模型决定。技术细节（消息、状态、工具）在下面的“使用”和“投递语义”。
section: 场景：一个管理线 + 多条执行线

text:
dsh-agent-lines README · 使用：管理线可以完全由对话驱动：

> 你是管理线。用 `line_create` 创建 frontend-line、backend-line、ops-line，然后用 `line_list` 确认。

工具：

dsh-agent-lines README · 使用：| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `line_status` | 只读：当前会话绑定、manager Session 是否存在/live、线列表、修复命令；未绑定也可见 |
| `line_claim_manager` | 把当前 live 根 Session 绑成 manager；需要 `allowClaim: true` 和 `confirm: "bind-manager"`；全局工具，不需要 shell |
| `line_list` | 列出线、状态、未读数、当前线和 role |
| `line_create` | 仅管理线：在管理线工作区（或指定的已有工作区）创建 DSH Session 并注册为线；同 label 幂等 |
| `line_move_workspace` | 仅管理线：把已有线的 Session 挂到路径完全匹配的工作区 |
| `line_send` | 发到 `line` 或 `agent#line`；可选 `idempotencyKey`、`replyTo`、`noReply`、`forceDistinct`、`ttlMs` |
| `line_inbox` | 读当前线已投递消息 |
| `line_ack` | 确认已处理 |

dsh-agent-lines README · 使用：除 `line_status`、`line_claim_manager` 外，line 工具只注册在已绑定线的 Session 上；这两个控制工具是全局的：status 只读，claim 仅限根会话且受 allowClaim 控制。

`line_create` 在管理线所属工作区（没有工作区时回退当前目录）创建普通 DSH Session；它**不会**创建独立 OS 进程、profile 或端口，也不转移已有 Session。

创建的线会记录 `created_by`，进程重启时由管理线恢复。line_create 会解析管理线所属工作区并传 workspaceId（DSH 会自动 attach），所以新线出现在该工作区而不是“未分组”；如果管理线本身不在工作区，则回退 cwd，线保持未分组。传 `workspace`（已有路径或 id）可指定其他工作区。若某条线的 Session 还从未落盘，首次投递可能 `session/not-found`；给它发一条任务（或重新创建）即可让它持久化。

CLI：

dsh-agent-lines README · 使用：```bash
dsh-agent-lines list
dsh-agent-lines send --from frontend-line --to backend-line --text "hi"
dsh-agent-lines inbox --line backend-line
dsh-agent-lines ack --line backend-line --id msg_...

用 `--db` 或 `DSH_AGENT_LINES_DB` 指向插件同一个数据库。
dsh-agent-lines README · 传输：`transport` 默认 `sqlite`（local-first），也是 0.3 唯一发布的 transport；安装插件不需要 Postgres 或 Python 服务。

dsh-agent-lines README · 架构：~~~mermaid
flowchart LR
  U[用户] --> M[管理线 DSH Session]
  M -->|line_create / line_send| P[dsh-agent-lines]
  P --> Q[(SQLite lines.db)]
  P -->|prompt requestId| W1[前端线 Session]
  P -->|prompt requestId| W2[后端线 Session]
  W1 -->|line_inbox / line_ack| P
  W2 -->|line_inbox / line_ack| P
~~~

DSH 适配层负责线身份和“把消息送进 Session”；transport 负责持久消息和跨进程存储。默认是本地 SQLite。公开架构说明：[English](docs/ARCHITECTURE.en.md) | [中文](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)。

dsh-agent-lines README · 要求：- DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0`
- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`
- 本地文件系统（NFS/CIFS/SMB/FUSE 会被拒绝）

dsh-agent-lines README · 工作区：DSH 侧边栏按 workspace 的 sessionIds 成员表分组，不是按 cwd。line_create 通过 workspaceRegistry.resolveByPath 找到管理线所属工作区，传 workspaceId，DSH 会在创建时 attachSession，新线就不会落到“未分组”。如果管理线没有 workspace，插件回退 cwd，线仍未分组。

line_move_workspace 把已有线挂到目标 workspace。DSH 只在 Session cwd 与 workspace path 完全一致时允许 attach；否则插件返回 WORKSPACE_ATTACH_FAILED。它不能把 Session 迁移到不同目录（那需要新 Session/交接）。

dsh-agent-lines README · manager 绑定与 claim：manager 是一条真实的 DSH Session。你打开另一个会话时，它不是 manager，line 工具会刻意不出现；先调用 `line_status` 看当前绑定和修复命令。

根会话可以直接在对话里绑自己，不需要 shell：

```json
line_claim_manager({ "confirm": "bind-manager" })
```

插件会校验调用者是 live 根会话、释放旧 manager 租约、重绑 manager，并把选择写入 `manager_bindings`。不需要改 profile，也不需要重启；需要 `allowClaim: true`。

运维仍可用 CLI 兜底：

```bash
dsh-agent-lines claim --agent agent-demo --line manager --session "$DSH_SESSION_ID"
```

claim 不会对每个新会话自动执行：需要用户明确要求，或运维显式调用。

dsh-agent-lines README · 回声与重复保护：- 同 `idempotencyKey` 返回已有消息。
- 不传 key 时，同一 `dedupeWindowMs`（默认 5 秒）内的相同发送合并为一条；要故意发两条相同正文用 `forceDistinct: true`。
- `replyTo` 会让 `hop` 递增；超过 `maxReplyDepth`（默认 8）返回 `LINE_REPLY_DEPTH_EXCEEDED`。
- `noReply: true` 的消息不能被回复；尝试回复返回 `LINE_NO_REPLY`。
- 默认禁止自己发自己（`LINE_SELF_SEND_FORBIDDEN`）；确需给自己留笔记时设 `allowSelfSend: true`。

这是传输层保护，不保证两个 agent 不会主动继续聊天；用 `noReply` 和 reply depth 约束。

dsh-agent-lines README · 投递语义：`queued → claimed → delivered → acked`

- `delivered`：目标 DSH Session 已接受 prompt。
- `acked`：agent 显式调用 `line_ack`。
- **至少一次**；靠 DSH 的 `requestId` 幂等让重试在 Session 日志里“有效一次”。不是分布式 exactly-once。
- 接收方离线时消息留在队列；0.3 不自动拉起进程。
- **一个 Session 只能有一个 writer。** 不要在另一个 DSH 进程（例如主 Web UI）里打开某条线的 Session；否则会 `session/writer-held`。关掉另一个视图，或给线独立 Session。

dsh-agent-lines README · 安全：- 插件在 DSH Host 进程内运行，拥有主机权限；只安装可信包。
- 0.3 默认本地 SQLite，不开网络监听。
- 只有 `createFrom` 管理线能建线；`maxLines` 限制增长。
- 对端消息在 prompt 里明确标为 peer content，不是用户指令。
- 详见 [docs/SECURITY.md](docs/SECURITY.md)。

dsh-agent-lines README · 限制：- 不做交接；不能把 Session 迁移到不同目录。
- 多线是同进程多 Session，不是进程隔离。
- 一个插件实例只支持一个 manager/团队；同一个 DSH 进程里同时跑开发、小说等多个团队不支持；独立 profile/DB 只是临时 workaround，不是产品模型。
- 没有 `line_delete`；建线会产生持久行，测试也会留下真实记录。
- 空白线 Session 可能需要第一条任务后才落盘。
- 一个 Session 只能有一个 writer；不要从另一个 DSH 进程打开线 Session。
dsh-agent-lines README · 状态：实验性 `0.3.x`。DSH 处于 developer preview，API 可能变化；请同时锁定 DSH 与插件版本。

A drop-in super-agent alternative for DSH.

dsh-agent-lines README · dsh-agent-lines：Stop reopening sessions and copying context by hand. Give one lead agent a long-lived team: each member has a name and a role, messages survive restarts, and the lead collects and reports the results.

dsh-agent-lines README · When to use it：- You have a long-running project and do not want to re-explain the background every time.
- You want several agents to keep stable roles: research, architecture, UI/UX, development, testing, release, and operations.
- You need a fixed name for each role, so you can assign work directly.
- Work must survive closing a window or restarting DSH: messages and context should still be there.
- You want one lead agent to decompose work, create the team, track progress, collect results, and report back.

dsh-agent-lines README · Install：One-command install (recommended; no need to find a profile):

curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Lencen/dsh-agent-lines/main/install.sh -o install.sh
    bash install.sh

The script picks the DSH Web profile, installs the plugin, and verifies agent-lines. If it cannot decide, it lists existing profiles and tells you how to specify one.

dsh-agent-lines README · Install：**Restart DSH Web after install or update.** A running process does not load new plugin code. With no plugin config the plugin starts in zero-config mode: one unbound manager line, and a root Session can call line_claim_manager to bind itself. The explicit "Manager config" block is optional, for a fixed manager/worker setup.

Offline or when npm is unavailable, use the local tarball:

bash install.sh ./dsh-agent-lines-0.3.5.tgz

dsh-agent-lines README · Install：After install and restart, it works without a config. When you want a fixed manager/worker setup, paste the "Manager config" block below into the file printed by the installer.

dsh-agent-lines README · Manager config (optional)：```yaml
- id: agent-lines
  name: dsh-agent-lines
  config:
    agentId: agent-demo

Only `createFrom` may call `line_create`. Worker profiles should leave `allowCreate` false.

dsh-agent-lines README · New line bootstrap：When the manager calls line_create, the plugin queues a no-work onboarding message by default so the blank Session gets its first message and appears in the sidebar; pass bootstrap: false to skip it.

line_status / line_list return materialized, visibleInSidebar, and bootstrapQueued; a new line may remain blank until its first message.

dsh-agent-lines README · Quick start：1. Run the installer above.
2. **Restart DSH Web** so the plugin is loaded.
3. Open any root Session. The zero-config path needs no YAML.
4. Call line_status; if the Session is not bound, call line_claim_manager({ confirm: "bind-manager" }).
5. Say "create the first-use team"; wait for the member lines, then send the first task separately.

dsh-agent-lines README · First use: build a development team：Copy this into a new root Session. The prompt starts with binding, then creates one team. Replace the task later; do not let the manager execute the work.

section: First use: build a development team

text:
dsh-agent-lines README · Scenario: one manager, several execution lines：1. The lead creates members by role: research, architecture, UI/UX, development, testing, acceptance, release, operations.
2. You give the lead one concrete task, for example "add CSV export to the reports page, with tests and a one-page runbook."
3. The lead decomposes it and sends each part to the right member; every message stays local.
4. Members receive the task, execute it, acknowledge it, and reply to the lead when needed.
5. The lead collects results, resolves disagreements, and aligns the answer.
6. You see the lead's summary; each member keeps its own context and message history.
section: Scenario: one manager, several execution lines

text: dsh-agent-lines README · Scenario: one manager, several execution lines：This is a prompt-driven team pattern, not a built-in org chart: the lead model decides how to split work. Technical details are in "Use" and "Delivery semantics" below.
section: Scenario: one manager, several execution lines

text:
dsh-agent-lines README · Use：A manager can be driven entirely by conversation:

> You are the manager line. Create frontend-line, backend-line and ops-line with `line_create`, then list them with `line_list`.

Tools:

dsh-agent-lines README · Use：| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `line_status` | Read-only: current Session binding, manager Session live/persisted, lines, repair command; visible even when unbound |
| `line_claim_manager` | Bind this live root Session as manager; requires `allowClaim: true` and `confirm: "bind-manager"`; global, no shell needed |
| `line_list` | List lines, status, unread counts, current line and role |
| `line_create` | Manager only: create a DSH Session in the manager workspace (or a named existing workspace) and register it as a line; same label is idempotent |
| `line_move_workspace` | Manager only: attach an existing line Session to a workspace whose path exactly matches the Session cwd |
| `line_send` | Send to `line` or `agent#line`; optional `idempotencyKey`, `replyTo`, `noReply`, `forceDistinct`, `ttlMs` |
| `line_inbox` | Read delivered messages for the current line |
| `line_ack` | Acknowledge a delivered message |

dsh-agent-lines README · Use：Line tools other than `line_status` and `line_claim_manager` are registered only on Sessions bound to a line. Both control tools are global: `line_status` is read-only, and `line_claim_manager` is root-only and gated by `allowClaim`.

dsh-agent-lines README · Use：`line_create` creates an ordinary DSH Session in the manager workspace (or in the manager cwd when no workspace exists). It does **not** create a separate OS process, profile, or port; all lines in that call share the DSH process. It also does not transfer an existing Session.

dsh-agent-lines README · Use：Created lines are recorded with `created_by` and restored by the manager on process startup. line_create uses the manager's workspace (workspaceId, so DSH attaches the Session) when one exists; otherwise it falls back to the manager cwd and the line is ungrouped. Pass `workspace` (existing path or id) to create in another workspace. A line whose Session was never materialized may fail on first delivery with `session/not-found`; send it a task (or recreate it) to persist the Session.

CLI:

dsh-agent-lines README · Use：```bash
dsh-agent-lines list
dsh-agent-lines send --from frontend-line --to backend-line --text "hi"
dsh-agent-lines inbox --line backend-line
dsh-agent-lines ack --line backend-line --id msg_...

Use `--db` or `DSH_AGENT_LINES_DB` to point the CLI at the plugin's database.
dsh-agent-lines README · Transports：`transport` defaults to `sqlite` (local-first) and is the only transport shipped in 0.3. Installing the plugin never requires Postgres or a Python service.

dsh-agent-lines README · Architecture：~~~mermaid
flowchart LR
  U[User] --> M[Manager DSH Session]
  M -->|line_create / line_send| P[dsh-agent-lines]
  P --> Q[(SQLite lines.db)]
  P -->|prompt requestId| W1[Worker line Session A]
  P -->|prompt requestId| W2[Worker line Session B]
  W1 -->|line_inbox / line_ack| P
  W2 -->|line_inbox / line_ack| P
~~~

dsh-agent-lines README · Architecture：The DSH adapter owns line identity and delivery into a Session; the transport owns durable messages and cross-process storage. The default transport is local SQLite. Public architecture: [English](docs/ARCHITECTURE.en.md) | [中文](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md).

dsh-agent-lines README · Requirements：- DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.3.0`
- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`
- A local filesystem for the SQLite database (NFS/CIFS/SMB/FUSE are refused)

dsh-agent-lines README · Workspaces：DSH groups Sessions by workspace membership, not by cwd. line_create resolves the
manager's workspace with workspaceRegistry.resolveByPath and passes workspaceId,
so the new Session is attached and appears under that workspace instead of
"Ungrouped". If the manager has no workspace, the plugin falls back to cwd; the
line remains ungrouped until a workspace is created/attached.

dsh-agent-lines README · Workspaces：line_move_workspace attaches an existing line to a target workspace. DSH itself
only allows attachment when the Session cwd exactly equals the workspace path;
the plugin returns WORKSPACE_ATTACH_FAILED otherwise. It does not move a Session
between different directories (that would require a new Session/handover).

dsh-agent-lines README · Manager binding and claim：The manager line is a real DSH Session. If you open a different Session, it is not the manager and the line tools are intentionally absent. Use `line_status` to see the configured manager and repair instructions.

A root Session can bind itself without a shell:

```json
line_claim_manager({ "confirm": "bind-manager" })
```

dsh-agent-lines README · Manager binding and claim：The tool validates that the caller is a live root, releases the old manager lease, rebinds the manager line, and persists the choice in `manager_bindings`. No profile edit or restart is needed. It requires `allowClaim: true`.

An operator can still use the CLI:

```bash
dsh-agent-lines claim --agent agent-demo --line manager --session "$DSH_SESSION_ID"
```

Claim is never automatic for every new Session: it needs an explicit user request or an explicit CLI call.

dsh-agent-lines README · Echo and duplicate protection：- Same `idempotencyKey` returns the existing message.
- Without a key, identical sends within `dedupeWindowMs` (default 5s) collapse to one; use `forceDistinct: true` for two intentional identical messages.
- `replyTo` increments `hop`; over `maxReplyDepth` (default 8) is rejected with `LINE_REPLY_DEPTH_EXCEEDED`.
- A `noReply: true` message cannot be replied to; attempts fail with `LINE_NO_REPLY`.
- Self-send is rejected by default (`LINE_SELF_SEND_FORBIDDEN`); set `allowSelfSend: true` only for deliberate notes.

dsh-agent-lines README · Echo and duplicate protection：This is transport-level protection. It does not guarantee that two agents will not choose to keep chatting; use `noReply` and reply depth for that.

dsh-agent-lines README · Delivery semantics：- `delivered` means the target DSH Session accepted the prompt.
- `acked` means an agent explicitly called `line_ack`.
- Delivery is **at-least-once**; DSH's `requestId` idempotency makes retries effectively-once in the Session log. It is not a distributed exactly-once guarantee.
- An offline receiver keeps messages queued; 0.3 has no automatic process wake.
- **One Session, one writer.** Do not open a line's Session in another DSH process (for example the main Web UI). DSH rejects delivery with `session/writer-held`; close the other view or use a dedicated Session.

dsh-agent-lines README · Security：- The plugin runs in the DSH Host process with host permissions. Install only packages you trust.
- Default transport is local SQLite; no network listener in 0.3.
- Only the configured manager line can create lines; `maxLines` bounds growth.
- Peer messages are marked as peer content, not user instructions.
- See [docs/SECURITY.en.md](docs/SECURITY.en.md).

dsh-agent-lines README · Limitations：- No handover; no move of a Session between different directories.
- Same-process multi-line, not process isolation.
- One manager/team per plugin instance. Simultaneous teams (for example development and novel) in one DSH process are not supported; separate profile/DB is only a workaround, not the product model.
- No `line_delete`; a created line is durable, so testing creates real rows.
- A blank line Session may need its first task before it is persisted.
- DSH allows one writer per Session; do not open a line Session from another DSH process.
dsh-agent-lines README · Status：Experimental `0.3.x`. DSH is in developer preview and its APIs can change. Pin both the DSH version and this plugin's version.
